description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions related to fetching and processing user data, including a custom hook 'useUsers' for fetching user data from an API and a function 'aggregateUsersByDepartment' for aggregating user data by department.

methods.name: useUsers
methods.description: A React hook to fetch users from the backend, managing loading, error, and data states, with support for pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: aggregateUsersByDepartment
methods.description: A utility function that groups an array of user objects by their department, counting the number of users per department, excluding invalid or unknown departments.
